a9b4c6fccb271ea0e5fbecff5fbf516232b5d24f.note: Release fixes merged after the inventory snapshot, up to #7845. Translated in the per-language groups.

be73c3122c35c95d5540009272d810f7e0bb8170.note: Late changes from #7851, #7852, #7854, #7855, #7866, #7869 and #7870. Translated in every pack.

baselineNote: docs-i18n after #7809, whose manifests use English a2e3f13d80f1a994cb1c10c56fef8be59672ed62
method: Scope follows validate-pack.mjs: Markdown under docs/ excluding evidence, pr-evidence, screenshots, examples and i18n (140 guides; every pack has all 140, no orphans). english = git log -1 on docs/<path> at the source commit; translations = git log -1 on <lang>/<path> on docs-i18n. Date comparison flags candidates only. Every English first-parent change since the previous audit source was then content-compared with the packs: side-by-side reading of changed lines (German, spot checks in other packs), invariant code/link token comparison in all ten packs, line-structure alignment, and docs-i18n commit parity per language. Deferred Game Mode/ruleset guides are matched to the English version their translation reflects (translationMatchesEnglish). untranslatedChanges lists verified or token-evidenced English changes missing from the packs; it is a guide, not a substitute for comparing the whole file. approxProseWordsToTranslate counts English words added outside code fences by those changes and is used only to balance the groups.
perLanguageNotes: All 92 drifted paths are drifted in all ten packs. development/optional-agent-packages.md differs by pack (see its notes). No other pack-specific gap was found: differing commit references are group PR numbers (#7065/#7068/#7069/#7070) for the same chat-window sync, and ja's #7370/#7405 content was already present from its 2026-10-12 sync. Non-drift quirks left as is: de development/hierarchical-locations-prd-v3.md renders 12 code-span labels differently; ja/ko development/logging.md, de installation/macos-linux.md and de integrations/home-assistant.md each differ by one code token; pl/ru/hi agents/custom-agents.md related-guide order is corrected in this catch-up.
